# Imam Bahri Alwi

> Full-stack developer in Tangerang, Indonesia, building production web and mobile systems across frontend, backend, databases, authentication, payments, automation, and SEO. Primary stack: TypeScript, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, NestJS, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.

The site is a personal portfolio. Indonesian is the default language and is served
at the bare path; English lives under /en. Both languages carry the same content.

## Current role

Full-Stack Developer at Konten.com (June 2026 – present), a creator-clipping
platform. Work spans authentication, rewards and gamification, content systems,
and automation. Also built the Kelas Clipper backend domain: 76 endpoints,
22 PostgreSQL tables, and 23 production-safe migrations on a shared database
serving approximately 150,000 accounts.

## Projects

- [Satria Gear](https://www.imambahri.com/project/satria-gear): esports tournament platform with an admin operations dashboard, Midtrans payment automation, and an AI agent wired into Discord, GitHub Actions, and Vercel deploy logs
- [OpenClaw Discord AI Moderator](https://www.imambahri.com/project/openclaw): prototype testing whether AI agents can carry real community moderation workflows
- [TypeSynq Royale](https://www.imambahri.com/project/typesynq-royale): real-time multiplayer typing battle with on-chain betting on the Monad Testnet; top 6 at the official Monad Game Hackathon
- [Galaxy POS](https://www.imambahri.com/project/galaxy-pos): Laravel 8 point-of-sale with multi-branch support, a service-repair module, and WhatsApp status notifications
- [Maneka](https://www.imambahri.com/project/maneka): AI-powered career planning app built on Howard Gardner's Theory of Multiple Intelligences
